Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 515 identities would post 1932 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
